network_status.network: Analisi agrometeorologica e climatologica della Sardegna 2008-2009
network_status.summary_it: Il rapporto ARPAS inquadra l'evento del 27-28 novembre 2008 che interessò l'Ogliastra, ma pubblica dati pluviometrici e non un livello o una portata del Rio Cadula-Ardali. Le fonti Capoterra presenti nel record non appartengono a questo evento di Triei e non vengono usate come evidenza idraulica.
network_status.summary_en: The ARPAS report frames the 27-28 November 2008 event affecting Ogliastra, but publishes rainfall data rather than a stage or discharge for the Rio Cadula-Ardali. The Capoterra sources attached to the record concern a different event and are not used as hydraulic evidence.

provenance.method: Manual extraction encoded in the ARCUS event-report curation registry

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
